root.text: Greetings, tactician. The Crown requires your aid.

mission_brief.text: The Valley is overrun. We need defenses built immediately.

root.text: I have secrets to sell, if you have the coin.

secret_sold.text: The Outcasts are planning an ambush in the swamps. Be ready.

root.text: The Light reveals corruption everywhere. Will you help us cleanse it?

blessing.text: May the Light protect your towers.

root.text: Crown men hunt us like dogs. But we bite back. You help us?
